an3.48:1.1: Himavantaṃ bhikkhave pabbatarājaṃ nissāya mahāsālā tīhi ca vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti.
an3.48:1.3: Sākhāpattapalāsena vaḍḍhanti tacapapaṭikāya vaḍḍhanti pheggusārena vaḍḍhanti.
an3.48:1.4: Himavantaṃ bhikkhave pabbatarājaṃ nissāya mahāsālā imāhi tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti.
an3.48:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saddhaṃ kulapatiṃ nissāya antojano tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhati.
an3.48:2.3: Saddhāya vaḍḍhati sīlena vaḍḍhati paññāya vaḍḍhati.
an3.48:2.4: Saddhaṃ bhikkhave kulapatiṃ nissāya antojano imāhi tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhatī ti.
